text:
tara_cs: Drafting a short 'SmartPlan' handoff for accounts with surprise surges. Purpose: give CS an email + tiny engineering checklist to reduce renewal risk.

tara_cs: TL;DR checklist for customers: 1) prefill 2 messages server-side, 2) switch to small batching for flushes, 3) stream only for live typing flows, 4) set soft token alerts and escalation rules, 5) capture 1-question feedback 24h after go-live.

ivan_se: can we include a paste-ready batch snippet and a one-liner to toggle streaming in our SDK? customers love copy/paste.

tara_cs: added below. kept it tiny.

tara_cs: ```
# curl - small batch example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","inputs":["title: summarize","note: simplify"],"max_tokens":120,"stream":false}'

# SDK toggle to streaming (one-liner, pseudo)
await client.generate({model:'redwood-lite', input:prompt, stream:true})
```

rachel_sre: ops bullets to include for the handout:
- prefix cache TTL: 30s (mobile) / 90s (low churn enterprise)
- per-tenant concurrency: default 3; raise on request
- warm pool: pre-warm 1 shard for scheduled launches (5-10m prior)
- auto-fallback: if p50 latency > 350ms for 1m, prefer batch responses and reduce max_tokens by 25% for mobile agents

mike_pm: renewal signal idea: set 'surge_watch' if 7-day rolling avg tokens >65% of monthly quota AND daily peak > 2x baseline. Trigger: create CS ticket + suggested mitigation list.

tara_cs: included 'surge_watch' rule and a short outreach template: "Hey <name>	we're seeing a usage surge that may hit your monthly budget. Would you like help tightening prompts or a temporary burst while you scale?" short and helpful.

ivan_se: add a tiny prompt optimization tip for CS to suggest: prefer concatenation when you need a single coherent reply instead of parallel batches (saves output-token duplication).

tara_cs: added prompt tip. Also added a minimal customer-facing checklist for engineers: 
- prefill 2 session-starters
- buffer up to 4 offline messages and flush as a batch
- stream when user is actively typing; otherwise batch
- set X-Client-Mode header (mobile|web|server) for routing

rachel_sre: health policy to include in the handout: create alert if reconnections >3 per session AND token burn increases >30% day-over-day -> escalate to CSM as 'connectivity-risk'.

healthbot: Confluence doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/smartplan-handoff (access: customer-success, product)

tara_cs: final ask: please review edits by EOD. I'll attach this SmartPlan to the low-touch kickoff and the renewal playbook if no objections. :white_check_mark:
